component.name: WhisPaste
component.summary: Voice-input tool: hotkey, speak, paste anywhere

description.p: WhisPaste is a voice-input tool. Press a global hotkey, speak, and the transcribed text is pasted at the cursor position of whatever application you are currently typing in — system-wide, not bound to a single app.

Transcription runs locally on your device via whisper.cpp (no network traffic) or, optionally, through a cloud provider you choose. The local Sprachdienst is downloaded automatically on first use; audio never leaves your device in local mode.
WhisPaste is explicitly not an always-listening assistant, not a recording or file-transcription tool, and not a voice-command system — its output is text that flows into the active application.
